head_commit.message:
Expand CORA integration documentation

Add comprehensive sections to CORA_INTEGRATION.md:
- Tool reference with detailed cora_learn API docs
- Architecture diagrams showing MCP integration flow
- Configuration examples for dev/prod/multi-env setups
- Troubleshooting guide for common issues
- Development guide for building and extending
- Practical usage examples and workflows
- Integration mapping to Celaya LMU components
- Performance considerations and optimization
- Security notes on sandboxing and validation
- References and changelog

Documentation now provides complete guide for CORA MCP
server setup, usage, and integration with Codex.
